text:
Aurelia Air will open a hub at Castellane Airfield on 14 March 2026, the airline's Chief Operating Officer, Marguerite Delacroix-Venn, confirmed.

The launch rests on the Hub Development Agreement between the carrier and the Castellane Airfield Authority, which was signed at a public ceremony on 9 January 2026. The document sets out the terms under which Aurelia Air will base operations at the airfield.

The hub will begin with 18 daily departures, according to the agreement and Ms Delacroix-Venn's confirmation. The airline expects the operation to create about 1,200 local jobs.

Castellane Airfield has not previously served as a base for a carrier of this kind. The opening marks the first stage of the arrangement set out in the signed agreement. Ms Delacroix-Venn said the launch date was confirmed and that preparations for the first day of operations were proceeding.
